class.name: InputEventGaze
class.brief_description: Input event emitted when face and eye gaze tracking is actively locked.
class.description: Provides localized 2D gaze coordinates via get_eye_gaze() and get_nose_gaze(), as well as 3D head pose and eye gaze ray properties in Godot camera space.

method.name: is_face_tracked
method.description:
Indicates whether valid face tracking data is present in this event.
bool True if face is tracked; false for missing or lost tracking events.
bool True if face is tracked; false for missing or lost tracking events.

method.name: get_eye_gaze
method.description:
Retrieves the 2D eye gaze coordinates on the viewport canvas or relative to a specified CanvasItem.
p_local_to Optional CanvasItem (e.g. Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns the position in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If provided, transforms the position into the local coordinate space of that CanvasItem. p_clamping Viewport boundary clamping behavior (CLAMPING_FREE, CLAMPING_CLAMPED, or CLAMPING_DEFAULT). Vector2 Gaze position in canvas space or local coordinates.
Optional CanvasItem (e.g. Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns the position in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If provided, transforms the position into the local coordinate space of that CanvasItem.
Viewport boundary clamping behavior (CLAMPING_FREE, CLAMPING_CLAMPED, or CLAMPING_DEFAULT).
Vector2 Gaze position in canvas space or local coordinates.

method.name: set_eye_gaze
method.description:
Sets the 2D eye gaze position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates.
p_pos Position in root Viewport Canvas coordinates.
Position in root Viewport Canvas coordinates.

method.name: get_nose_gaze
method.description:
Retrieves the 2D nose gaze coordinates (nose-forward ray projected to the display) on the canvas or relative to a CanvasItem.
Represents the forward projection of the head pose onto the screen surface.
p_local_to Optional CanvasItem (e.g. Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns the position in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If provided, transforms the position into the local coordinate space of that CanvasItem. p_clamping Viewport boundary clamping behavior (CLAMPING_FREE, CLAMPING_CLAMPED, or CLAMPING_DEFAULT). Vector2 Nose gaze projection in canvas space or local coordinates.
Optional CanvasItem (e.g. Node2D or Control). If null (default), returns the position in canonical root Viewport Canvas space (pixels). If provided, transforms the position into the local coordinate space of that CanvasItem.
Viewport boundary clamping behavior (CLAMPING_FREE, CLAMPING_CLAMPED, or CLAMPING_DEFAULT).
Vector2 Nose gaze projection in canvas space or local coordinates.

method.name: set_nose_gaze
method.description:
Sets the 2D nose gaze position in canonical root Viewport Canvas coordinates.
p_pos Position in root Viewport Canvas coordinates.
Position in root Viewport Canvas coordinates.

method.description:
Sets the underlying 3D head transform in Godot camera space.
p_xform 3D transform of the head.
3D transform of the head.

method.description:
